column1: # binary<TAB>test<TAB>CI seconds. AET-WO-4300b refit (REFIT RULE fired: shard 2 at 21m47s on dda613d): each test run alone on a GitHub runner in the pinned image, run 43767871690 (2026-11-15);

# then, by the architect's ruling on PR #152 (comment 6903399822, Q10 (b)), every CPU-heavy test (Kani, verify, board_tier2, the timing test an_aborted_machine_...) at its WORST IN-SHARD time over runs 43771580225 and 43774296207 (method in ci/shard.sh's REFIT RULE).
# Only tests of 0.5 s or more are listed; a test not listed here gets DEFAULT_WEIGHT in ci/shard.sh. Binaries in ci/colocate.tsv are weighed there, as blocks.
# AET-WO-4230 refit (2026-11-16), by rule 5 of ci/shard.sh's REFIT RULE, from the normal run 43875567562 (head 2bb9ee4, green): every CPU-heavy test
# (board_tier2, verify_2k2_tier2, twin_tier2's two Kani tests and its timing test, with_tools' tests of 5 s or more) at its worst in-shard time
# (behind a lock: its `ok` less the previous lock-holder's; else its `ok` less its binary's `Running`, an upper bound), kept at the earlier run's
# weight where that was larger and the test's code did not change on this branch. Measured larger, so raised; earlier larger, so kept: twin_tier2's
# three, board_tier2's every_corpus_file, the_power_fixture and three under 2 s, with_tools' prove_of_an_unresolvable, parity_fails, the_class_and_pair,
# the_through_hole. the_full_power_fixture's 31.8 was a Furnace estimate (AET-WO-1310, times 2.8), not a run: replaced by its measured 17.497.
# board_tier2's a_missing_clock_enable_fails and a_vacuous_harness_fails moved to the SPI setup harness after that run (e13174f): each weighed at
# max(its in-image time on 6e8ce74 times 1.5, 10 s) = 10 s (measured 4.18 s and 3.57 s, libtest's `finished in`, alone, pinned image on Furnace).
# twin_tier2's every_bit_the_reference_writes_is_covered_by_a_ledger_row (this branch; was a 5 s estimate): its `ok` less twin_tier2's `Running`, 31.045, an upper bound.

# AET-WO-4230 follow-up refit (2026-11-16), rule 5, from normal runs 43889629997 (9b989a0) and 43895706619 (fdfd2b8), both green: every CPU-heavy test above at its worst in-shard time over the two runs, kept where 43875567562's row is larger and its code unchanged (lowered, code changed: board_tier2's a_missing_clock_enable_fails and a_vacuous_harness_fails, from the 10 s floor; twin_tier2's every_bit_...); each test with no row that measured 0.5 s or more gets one at its worst `ok` less its binary's `Running` over the two runs, an upper bound (144 rows); other rows and the four AET-WO-1310 estimates (all above their measured bounds) kept.

# AET-WO-4220b: board_tier2's the_own_parts_fixture_passes_erc_drc_with_parity_and_extract is a Furnace estimate (6.47 s in the pinned image, times 2.8 as AET-WO-1310's), not a run, until the refit rule measures it.
# AET-WO-1310: Furnace, each alone (tier 1 on the host, tier 2 in the pinned image), times 2.8.

# AET-WO-4230 follow-up: against_fab_tier2 split out of ci/colocate.tsv. Each test alone runs the shared --fab-out verify, then its own --against-fab verify, one at a time: 2 x 579 s, the worst single verify of the block in runs 43889629997 and 43895706619 (510-579 s; an upper bound).

# AET-WO-1312: board_tier2's the_bench_board_passes_every_gate_at_two_and_four_layers is a Furnace estimate, not a run: 8.54 s in the pinned image on Furnace, times 2.8 (AET-WO-1310's factor), 23.912; replace it at the next refit.

# AET-WO-1313: board_tier2's the_sentinel_03_fixture_passes_every_gate_inside_its_bound is a Furnace estimate, not a run: 8.28 s in the pinned image on Furnace, times 2.8 (AET-WO-1310's factor), 23.184; replace it at the next refit.
# AET-WO-2302 (interim, refit from this PR's CI run by rule 5 if the plan or the shards call for it): each new twin_tier2
# test weighed from its Furnace wall in the pinned image times 1.2 (the ratio of CI to Furnace on the reference boot),

# AET-WO-4400d: with_tools' a_turned_keepout_is_where_kicad_draws_it is a Furnace estimate, not a run: 10.84 s alone in the pinned image on Furnace, times 2.0 (a_part_on_each_edge_passes_erc_and_drc's 6.017 s on CI over its 3.00 s measured beside it), 21.680; replace it at the next refit.

# AET-WO-1313c: Furnace estimates, not runs (each test alone, times 2.8 as AET-WO-1310's), until the refit rule measures them: board_tier2's each_size_sample (16.3 s in the pinned image), outline_tier1's four (4.05, 16.13 on up to 8 threads, 3.99, and the turned IMU's 10.90 s after 4400d, on the host) and pcb's two order tests (3.43, 0.68 s).

# AET-WO-4220c: models_tier2's five FIFO tests below are estimates, not measurements (the file's other tests take 3.8-5.2 s on CI; these add the FIFO bursts' monitor commands), until the refit rule measures them.

# AET-WO-1314 refit (2026-11-18), ruling 6989277256 on PR #227, REFIT RULE 5, from run 44372757248 (head a9b79f43; shard 1 cancelled at the 45 min guard): every test whose cost this PR changed (it emits, extracts or verifies a board with fab_tolerances, so the capacitance ladder routes it eight times) at its worst in-shard time: board_tier2's Sentinel-03 and power-fixture cases (behind its lock: `ok` less the previous holder's), and every test of outline_tier1, power_board_tier1, supply_tier1, via_ring_tier1, and solve_cli's power-tree emit (`ok` less the binary's `Running`, an upper bound). supply_tier1 (1303b) and via_ring_tier1 (new) had no rows, so DEFAULT_WEIGHT 0.05 s each, which is why shard 1 ran over. the_full_power_fixture kept at its larger earlier row. No other row changed.
# AET-WO-1910 build (ruled on PR #233, comment 6999515740): rows naming no listed test removed (P1 refuses them: 7 renamed or removed tests,
# and the four-layer pair moved to four_layer_fab_tier2.rs, campaign_tier1's two D4 tests removed); rows of colocated binaries removed (their
# blocks in ci/colocate.tsv weigh them). Added, by REFIT RULE 5 from the census runs 44426540986, 44433378021 and 44441889769 (each test's
# worst in-shard time over the three: its `ok` less its reconstructed start, libtest name order on 4 threads; in a lock-serialised binary its
# `ok` less the previous completion): every listed test with no row that measured 0.5 s or more, and every test of a lock-serialised binary
# (ONE_AT_A_TIME, RENODE_TURN) with no row, at least 0.1 s, so P2 never reads its queue time as an unweighted heavy test.
# AET-WO-1910 refit after the build (REFIT RULE 5), from its first run, 44461834066 (head bc31f19c, green): every row re-weighed at its
# in-shard time there (`ok` less its reconstructed start; behind ONE_AT_A_TIME or RENODE_TURN, `ok` less the previous completion), because the
# build changed what most tests cost: D7 (svd-hal and sha2 at opt-level 2) every test that runs the dev-built CLI, D1-D3 the shared runs.
# Rows of 0.5 s or more, and every test of a lock-serialised binary at least 0.1 s; the blocks in ci/colocate.tsv at their in-process time there.
# Then at the worse of that run and the next, 44466633965 (head 8b18b060, green), by the same rule: the heavy verify and Kani blocks ran
# 10-30 % slower there (runner variance), so the plan weighs each test and block at its worst of the two.
# supply_tier1 and via_ring_tier1 left these rows for ci/colocate.tsv: their tests share OnceLock boards, so a per-test time counts the shared run once per waiter (REFIT RULE 3).

# AET-WO-2304b (K7 carve-out): twin_tier2's battery_sag::sentinel_03_s_campaign_... and battery_sag::the_power_fixture_s_campaign_... are Furnace estimates, not runs: 121.02 s and 39.41 s alone in the pinned image on Furnace (libtest's `finished in`), times 2.8 (AET-WO-1310's factor); replace them from the first CI run.
